movelist.name: Smokescreen
movelist.effect: Smokescreen creates a blast of Smoke that covers the target area; the Smoke persists until the end of the encounter, or until Defog or Whirlwind are used. All targets attacking from or into the Smoke receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Poison Gas
movelist.effect: Poison Gas Poisons all Legal Targets.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves Flinch Targets on a roll of 18+. If a move already has a chance of Flinching foes, the Effect Range is increased by +3 instead. Whenever the user Flinches a foe with an attack, that foe gains a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!
